solvers.name: hddc2b_example_frc
description: Find a solution to the force distribution problem for a situation where the
platform is either **singular** (less than one drive unit) or **redundant**
(two or more drive units), compute the weight decomposition internally and
include a reference drive force in the nullspace.

solvers.name: hddc2b_example_vel
description: Find a solution to the velocity composition problem for a situation where the
platform is either **singular** (less than one drive unit) or **redundant**
(two or more drive units).

solvers.name: ex_frc_pltf_to_pvt_redu_sing_pinv
description: Find a solution to the force distribution problem for a situation where the
platform is either **singular** (less than one drive unit) or **redundant**
(two or more drive units).

solvers.name: ex_frc_pltf_to_pvt_redu_sing_ref_pinv
description: Find a solution to the force distribution problem for a situation where the
platform is either **singular** (less than one drive unit) or **redundant**
(two or more drive units) and include a reference drive force in the
nullspace.

solvers.name: ex_frc_pltf_to_pvt_sing_dls
description: Find a solution to the force distribution problem for a situation where the
platform is **singular** (less than one drive unit).

solvers.name: ex_frc_pltf_to_pvt_redu_ref_pinv
description: Find a solution to the force distribution problem for a situation where the
platform is **redundant** (more than one drive unit).

solvers.name: ex_vel_pvt_to_pltf_sing_dls
description: Find a solution to the velocity composition problem for a situation where the
platform is **singular** (less than one drive unit).

solvers.name: hddc2b_example_vel_dist
description: Distribute a platform-level velocity to the pivot frames.
The distribution is split into an exact primary platform-twist task
and a secondary drive-space velocity reference projected into the
platform-task nullspace.
